## Minimized proposition

Following earlier email exchanges, a prospective hospitality-investment
counterparty contacted the project principal through a professional-network
direct message. The counterparty stated that no telephone number had been
located and proposed a brief synchronous conversation.

## What this supports

- A direct follow-up occurred after earlier emails.
- The counterparty sought a synchronous discussion.
- The absence of a known telephone route was presented as the practical reason

## What this does not support

The message does not establish:

- acceptance or execution of a confidentiality agreement;
- identification or approval of a fund, vehicle or mandate;
- mandate fit or investment-committee interest;
- commitment, financing, acquisition intent or transaction approval;
- knowledge of the separate legal-dispute record;
- any relationship between this commercial approach and any allegation,

- authority to publish the message, identity or native artifact.

## Privacy transformation

The repository derivative omits the sender’s name, employer, title, portrait,
profile URL, message time, message body, email address, phone detail, provider
identifier, private subject, asset identity and native checksum. The exact
artifact and its checksum remain in the private custody record.

## Controlled next action

Use the professional-network channel, if needed, only for a short appreciative
acknowledgement and redirection to the existing verified corporate-email thread.
Do not provide a telephone number or conduct the substantive exchange on the
professional-network platform or a messaging application.

Preserve the existing confidentiality sequence. After the NDA, receiving
perimeter, attendees and a mutually accepted time are confirmed by corporate
email, arrange the discussion through a corporate Google Calendar invitation
with a generated Google Meet link, an agenda and an agreed transcript. Preserve
the invitation, attendee record, transcript and post-meeting corporate-email
summary privately.

No website update, sitemap entry, navigation link, actor-page link, evidence-map
link or legal-proposition link is authorized.
